text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fuji! You're the culprit, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh! Now, whatever could you mean?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Look at this! The "Yumekawa Land ♡ 
Commemorative Cutie Coin" was in my 
pocket! ...Even though I lost the lottery!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You did mention the odds were tough, after 
all. I'm so glad I managed to win tickets 
with my entry!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Still, applying for that must've been a 
hassle, right?! Only Land members can 
enter, and there's a membership fee... Oh, 
you're the best!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...Since you went out of your way to 
surprise me, I'll be sure to pay you back 
in full."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, don't tense up. ...Today is your 
birthday, after all, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
No way, I'm not backing down. Not when you 
gave me something so wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, is that so? Then how about giving me 
a piece of your gum—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Don't you try to brush it off so lightly!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait, Fuji. You'd better look 
forward to your birthday too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haha, alright, Bubble. Then I'll give in 
and... look forward to it.
